external_entities.name: supplier
external_entities.description: Suppliers upload compliance paperwork and sign in to the portal using vendor-issued credentials.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal

external_entities.name: category manager
external_entities.description: Category managers review uploaded supplier paperwork and approve or reject it from the corporate network.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.

external_entities.name: vendor
external_entities.description: The vendor hosts the SaaS portal and pushes nightly supplier data extracts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: The portal is a SaaS product. The vendor hosts it

processes.name: supplier document portal
processes.description: A vendor-hosted SaaS portal through which suppliers upload compliance paperwork and category managers review and approve or reject it.

processes.name: supplier master service
processes.description: The service loads the nightly supplier data extract from the landing bucket and writes records into the supplier database.
processes.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file and writes the records into the supplier database.

data_stores.name: vendor's platform
data_stores.description: The vendor platform where supplier compliance documents remain stored.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.

data_stores.name: landing bucket
data_stores.description: A bucket in the organisation's cloud account that receives the nightly supplier data extract.
data_stores.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.

data_stores.name: supplier database
data_stores.description: The database in the organisation's cloud account where the supplier master service writes extracted records.
data_stores.source_excerpt: The bucket, the service and the database are all in our cloud account.

data_flows.name: upload paperwork
data_flows.source_excerpt: Suppliers upload their compliance paperwork through a portal
data_flows.data_description: Insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

data_flows.name: store documents
data_flows.source_excerpt: The documents themselves stay in the vendor's platform.
data_flows.data_description: Supplier compliance paperwork, including insurance certificates, food safety audits, and staff contact details.

data_flows.name: review submissions
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our category managers, who work from the corporate network, review what has been uploaded and approve or reject it.
data_flows.data_description: Uploaded supplier compliance paperwork and approval or rejection decisions.

data_flows.name: push supplier extract
data_flows.source_excerpt: Every night the vendor pushes a supplier data extract to a landing bucket in our cloud account.
data_flows.notes: The source says, "We were told the nightly extract is encrypted end to end." The runbook says, "the file arrives as a plain CSV and is picked up as-is." These claims do not establish a single encryption-in-transit value.

data_flows.name: load extract
data_flows.source_excerpt: Our supplier master service loads that file

data_flows.name: write records
data_flows.source_excerpt: writes the records into the supplier database
data_flows.data_description: Supplier records from the nightly extract.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier document portal presents a web interface because the text calls it a portal.
assumptions.basis: The source describes the system as a supplier document portal.

assumptions.assumption: The vendor platform's stored supplier documents are confidential because they include personal staff contact details and compliance paperwork.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the platform stores insurance certificates, food safety audits, and contact details for suppliers' staff.

assumptions.assumption: The landing bucket's supplier extract is confidential because it contains supplier data derived from the stated paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the bucket receives a supplier data extract, and identifies the extracted supplier information as including compliance paperwork and staff contact details.

assumptions.assumption: The supplier database records are confidential because they are supplier records derived from the stated paperwork and staff contact details.
assumptions.basis: The source states that the supplier master service writes supplier extract records into the supplier database; the described supplier data includes staff contact details and compliance paperwork.
